entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who petrifies her double in the Implicit Maze, stabs the Theorist with an Ochran dagger to end the overlay, and gifts Jace a kind death.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage, whole again after his aberrations reintegrate, who dies from Vraska's knife to end the overlay.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The part of Jace who weaves the two Multiverses together with his mind, losing his memories as he works, until the aberrations overtake him.

entities.name: The Detective
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who advises Vraska to aim at forty-seven degrees and cuts the Theorist's connection to the weaving.

entities.name: The Nihilist
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who encourages Vraska not to flinch and slams a wall of hopelessness around the Theorist's consciousness.

entities.name: The Survivor
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who tells Vraska to tuck and roll and stands aside during the reintegration.

entities.name: The Soldier
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who advises killing swiftly and plucks out the part of the Theorist's mind that remembers how to breathe.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who tells Vraska to turn the shield toward the target and binds the aberrations together.

entities.name: The Warden
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who forces the Theorist to kneel and fills his mind with visions of his tormentors.

entities.name: The Clean Slate
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who carves a path to the Theorist's brain stem.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A student apprentice taught by the Theorist who runs through the overlay and reunites with her friend Kirol, believing it is her job to stop the overlay.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire and Tam's friend who hugs her and distrusts her but does not want her dead; Kirol goes to find the others.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who launches Vraska with an explosion and helps her get through the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who fights his double and rips the Chain Veil from the other Garruk.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A druid planeswalker who fights the cryomancer Chandra and joins the final fight.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who confronts the Theorist and, as part of the plan, distracts him; she forgives and consoles Jace.

entities.name: Lich Professor Opal
entities.description: The reanimated corpse of Professor Opal, Liliana's puppet and double, who kicks and tackles the Theorist.

entities.name: Vraska's double
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Vraska who commands a stone Niv-Mizzet, is turned to stone, and later helps the Theorist; she was never known pain.

entities.name: Cryomancer Chandra
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Chandra who summons an ice field.

entities.name: Garruk's double
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Garruk who summons beasts and carries the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Ajani's double
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Ajani.

entities.name: Chandra's double
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Chandra who sends fire.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet statue
entities.description: A massive stone statue of Niv-Mizzet animated by the will of Vraska's double in the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Dellian Fel
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor who walks calmly through falling rubble, conjuring plants.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The oracle whom Tam believes is dead.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A resident of Bloomburrow who sees a shadow of her home, of her littles, in the second world.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A resident of Amonkhet who shivers and looks to Hazoret for guidance.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: An Amonkhet god who leads Samut and Djeru to face the illusion.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: An Amonkhet resident who goes with Samut and Hazoret.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A Dominarian knight who sees a specter of an army on the plain and calls the host of angels to ready.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx among the monsters that forced Jace to hurt others.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: One of the monsters that forced Jace to hurt others.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A monster in the Warden's visions that forced Jace to hurt others.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose death Liliana says is part of why this time there's only Jace.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact carried by the Echoverse's double of Garruk, ripped away by Ajani; it also appears in Liliana's mind.

entities.name: The Ochran dagger
entities.description: A dagger Vraska plunges into Jace's heart to end the overlay and gift a kind death.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The doubled version of Strixhaven that merges first with the original.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school where the Echoverse's double overlays.

entities.name: The Folioplex
entities.description: The Hexhaven version of the library.

entities.name: The Implicit Maze
entities.description: The Ravnican maze where Jace became the Living Guildpact, visited as a memory room.

entities.name: The Tower
entities.description: Jace's tower with a sanctum, orrery and mage-rings.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose double floats above Tin Street.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane where a second world appears alongside the first.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane with snow-capped pyramids floating above Naktamun.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where a specter army appears and the earthquake trembles.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane whose slang Kirol uses.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The mirror Multiverse the Theorist created and is now overlaying on the original.

entities.name: The Multiverse
entities.description: The original reality being overlaid by its copy.

entities.name: Holmberg's Paradox
entities.description: The principle that the illusion is inherently connected to the wielder's physical body.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose fools are seen watching the doubled Ravnica.

entities.name: Konstrari cadets
entities.description: Hexhaven cadets who nudge falling pieces into place.

entities.name: The Ochran
entities.description: The Golgari assassins whose dagger kills Jace.

events.summary: Across the Multiverse the worlds begin to overlay; on Ravnica, Bloomburrow, Amonkhet and Dominaria, people see doubles of their worlds.
events.quote: Meanwhile, the worlds begin to overlay.

events.summary: Tam runs from the tower as Hexhaven merges into Strixhaven, believing Jadzi is dead.
events.quote: She's too late. Jadzi must be dead.

events.summary: Hexhaven doppelgangers attack new Strixhaven students while Dellian Fel calmly conjures plants.
events.quote: The blank-eyed doppelgängers of Hexhaven flock to these new students

events.summary: Tam realizes the Theorist taught her everything except how to separate the planes once combined, and tries to push against the Echoverse's seam.
events.quote: He knows how two planes combined … but not how to separate them once the process begins.

events.summary: Tam hears Kirol, uses chance magic to deflect falling cobblestones, and saves them.
events.quote: and pulls at the threads of chance that crisscross high above.

events.summary: Kirol and Tam reunite in a hug; Tam apologizes and explains the overlay.
events.quote: Kirol lurches forward, shoving past the throngs of people between them, and envelops Tam in a hug.

events.summary: Tam explains her teacher's theorem cannot be reversed while part of him lives; Kirol tells her she will solve it and leaves to find their friends.
events.quote: "You're going to solve it," they say with certainty.

events.summary: Tam feels small and incomplete as the overlay spreads across the Multiverse and she is swallowed by the crowd.
events.quote: In this moment, Tam feels that she is inadequacy.

events.summary: Vraska arrives in the Implicit Maze and Chandra tackle-hugs her; Chandra explains that their doubles sent the group there.
events.quote: He had our doubles tackle us through portals, which sent us here.

events.summary: Vraska's double commands a stone Niv-Mizzet statue and guards the mage-ring with the other doubles.
events.quote: The other Vraska sits atop the head of a stone Niv-Mizzet.

events.summary: Vraska plans to be launched by Chandra's explosion to petrify her double, guided by the aberrations in her mind.
events.quote: "You're going to launch me high enough that I can petrify my double."

events.summary: Chandra launches Vraska into the air and she lands on the dragon's head.
events.quote: She is launched, and the wind—the wind!

events.summary: Vraska petrifies her double, freezing the dragon, and shoves the statue over the side.
events.quote: Skin turns to stone, and the other Vraska solidifies with a look of mild confusion on her face.

events.summary: The friends beat their doubles, Garruk knocks down the cryomancer, Ajani rips away the Chain Veil, and Chandra sends fire.
events.quote: roaring as he rips the ancient artifact away with a swipe of his claws.

events.summary: Vraska takes her petrified double's dress as a disguise and leads the others through the mage-ring.
events.quote: Vraska raises the hood over her head.

events.summary: The Theorist continues the overlay, weaving both Multiverses together while losing his memories.
events.quote: but he's losing himself, thread by thread.

events.summary: The Theorist commands his doppelgangers to kill anyone who tries to stop the overlay and aligns his mage-rings.
events.quote: Kill anyone who attempts to stop the overlay.

events.summary: Liliana and the lich of Professor Opal interrupt the Theorist's omniscience and try to talk him down.
events.quote: and he sees in front of him Liliana, Professor Opal at her side as a lich.

events.summary: Liliana tells the Theorist she was once him and knows power brings emptiness; he calls her a manipulative snake.
events.quote: "Because I was you! I betrayed my allies and I betrayed myself and all I won was loneliness!"

events.summary: The Echoverse's Vraska arrives and the lich tackles and kicks the Theorist, forcing him to unleash his mind.
events.quote: the lich kicks him in the head.

events.summary: The Theorist attacks Liliana's mind with her worst memories, but her double heals her.
events.quote: He drowns her heart in the image of himself failing to stop Phyrexia.

events.summary: Vraska, in her double's disguise, stabs the Theorist in the heart with a knife while Chandra, Ajani and Garruk emerge from a portal.
events.quote: Something sharp pierces the Theorist's heart, and he gasps.

events.summary: The aberrations rush into the Theorist and overtake his mind, each taking a role in subduing him.
events.quote: They overtake his mind like a tsunami.

events.summary: The aberrations reintegrate into one and Jace opens his eyes, whole again.
events.quote: Plural becomes singular. The aberrations, the parts, become one.

events.summary: Jace gives each of his friends a final message, and Liliana forgives him.
events.quote: Liliana smiles. I'm sorry, Jace. Rest unburdened.

events.summary: The overlay's threads fade as the knife in his heart ends the false Multiverse's tether.
events.quote: Above, the orrery has paused, the threads tying the two Multiverses together fading with the beating of his heart.

events.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms, unafraid, after thanking her.
events.quote: In the quiet of the sanctum with the now separated orrery overhead, Jace goes still.

relations.quote: he says, looking into his beloved's eyes.

relations.note: Vraska's knife gives Jace the kind death he agreed to.
relations.quote: courtesy of Vraska's final mercy, his passing is swift and just, a death he deserves.

relations.note: The Theorist taught Tam everything he knew.
relations.quote: The Theorist taught her everything he knew

relations.note: Kirol calls her a friend despite distrust.
relations.quote: "I don't trust you in the slightest, but I don't want you dead."

relations.note: The Echoverse's Vraska steps through and moves to his side.

relations.quote: Professor Opal at her side as a lich.
Vraska bursts from behind the frill and looks her double straight in the eyes.
